evidence_assessment.finding: Layer 1 did not manipulate total delivered context: profile and fixed blocks bypassed the nominal world cap, while the scorer rewarded profile recitation. The run is evidence about instrument invalidity, not memory capacity.
Internal epistemic state did not reach Zero's prompt and system AUROC 0.465 was below both question-only observers. State existence therefore has zero self-knowledge credit at the output boundary.
Whole-context budgeting and prompt injection now exist in exported source, but no exact-source paired post-fix outcome is bound.

primary_sources.title: Towards Improving Selective Prediction Ability of NLP Systems
primary_sources.finding: Selective prediction can combine model confidence with instance difficulty; this supports requiring incremental epistemic value above a question-only difficulty baseline.

primary_sources.title: Adaptation with Self-Evaluation to Improve Selective Prediction in LLMs
primary_sources.finding: Self-evaluation should be judged with selective-prediction outcomes such as AUROC/AUACC, not merely more cautious language.

primary_sources.title: Language Models Don't Always Say What They Think: Unfaithful Explanations in Chain-of-Thought Prompting
primary_sources.finding: Verbalized reasoning can rationalize biased answers without revealing the causal influence; an injected epistemic line needs intervention evidence, not interpretation from its wording.

hypotheses.claim: Prompt-delivered epistemic state contains correctness information beyond item difficulty and answer style.
hypotheses.test: On a frozen exact source/tree and paired item order, compare EPISTEMIK=0 versus 1 and fit a question-only baseline. Require held-out incremental log-loss or AUROC improvement after conditioning on question difficulty; also report accuracy, coverage-risk, Brier/ECE, abstention and false-unknown rate.
hypotheses.falsifier: The injection changes hedging or abstention but adds no held-out predictive value beyond question-only difficulty, or reduces task accuracy without an improved risk-coverage frontier.

hypotheses.claim: The new 14500-character regulator constrains the complete delivered pre-stage context rather than one component.
hypotheses.test: Instrument per-turn identity, profile, world, evidence, epistemic and final character counts across adversarially varied profile sizes. Bind the trace to one atomic receipt and require final_chars <= 14500 or a typed ERROR.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any unreported side channel exceeds the cap, cap changes are non-monotonic, or overflow proceeds without a typed error.

hypotheses.claim: After separating task correctness from profile overlap, larger usable context improves task outcomes rather than merely increasing recitation.
hypotheses.test: Score semantic/task correctness independently, report profile n-gram/semantic overlap as a leakage axis, and randomize irrelevant profile payload at fixed total size.
hypotheses.falsifier: The apparent benefit tracks overlap or irrelevant profile size but not independently scored correctness.

counterhypotheses.attack: A visible KNOWN/UNKNOWN line may induce stylistic caution or copy a heuristic while conveying no residual knowledge of correctness.
The pre-fix transport path was absent, so the pilot cannot rule out post-fix residual epistemic value; it only sets a mandatory baseline.
Uncontrolled profile load and recitation reward can generate the same observed pattern without any memory-capacity gain.

new_concepts.name: Epistemic Residual Credit
new_concepts.definition: Self-knowledge credit granted only for held-out correctness prediction remaining after conditioning on item difficulty and observable answer-style signals.

new_concepts.name: Context Budget Conservation Law
new_concepts.definition: Every byte or character delivered across identity, profile, world, memory, evidence and epistemic channels must be counted in one conserved total or explicitly rejected.

new_concepts.name: Hedging-Only Improvement
new_concepts.definition: An intervention makes language more cautious without improving correctness discrimination or the risk-coverage frontier.

new_concepts.name: Prompt-Side Epistemic Placebo
new_concepts.definition: A self-knowledge annotation changes surface behavior because it is present in the prompt, while carrying no causal information beyond question difficulty.

routing.impulse: Run CSWT-Z v2 as a preregistered paired EPISTEMIK=0/1 study with a question-only difficulty baseline and held-out residual-value metric. Preserve the pre-fix 0.465 and observer 0.745/0.624 as negative baseline evidence.

Emit a per-turn CONTEXT_BUDGET_TRACE/v1 whose component totals reconcile exactly to final delivered characters and are bound to DB snapshot/WAL and TEST_EXPORT_ATOMIC_RECEIPT/v1. Reject or type overflow.
Treat the source changes as mechanism-only. Keep Frank/whole release NOT_PASS and do not alter Harness; resolve the persistent adapter red and atomic receipt gap before promotion.

negative_and_null_results: The Layer-1 pilot does not estimate capacity because its manipulation did not control total context.
Pre-fix epistemic AUROC 0.465 gives no self-knowledge credit and is weaker than the question-only observers.
Five repetitions imply the original small sample is below the reported noise floor; small differences are not promotion evidence.
The post-pilot budget and epistemic prompt changes have no bound causal efficacy receipt.
Current test state remains 583/1; atomic receipt, full source/tree and whole-product acceptance remain absent.
Target main and retained PR head did not change; no new runtime or deployment credit is claimed.

deduplication.policy: The pilot report, post-pilot source delta and repeated Gen182 exports are one same-host lineage. Literature sources motivate controls but are not independent replication of Clay/AgentZero outcomes.
